add_block.new_heading: Birthday package catering for parties, kids and corporate events
new_paragraphs: The right package depends on who's celebrating, and we shape three broad tracks around that. For a grown-up birthday package party in Dubai, think a canapé reception flowing into a plated dinner or a generous buffet with a live carving or pasta station. For children, a kids' bundle leans on familiar crowd-pleasers, smaller portions and a safe, allergy-aware kitchen. For a corporate birthday package in Dubai — a founder's milestone or a team celebration in the office — we work to a clean drop-off or buffet format that respects the working day. Birthday package catering for events in Dubai also covers milestone 40ths, 50ths and surprise parties where the brief is more formal. Whichever track you're on, one birthday package catering company handles the whole thing end to end, so you brief a single team instead of juggling a caterer, a chef and a rentals firm.

new_paragraphs: How much does birthday package catering cost in Dubai?

It starts from around AED 700 per person and is quoted by guest count, menu and service level. Set party packages run from AED 1,200 to AED 5,500 for defined guest bands. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What's included in a birthday package?

Included is menu design, a vetted chef cooking on site, service staff where needed, plating, setup and full cleanup. A bar, custom cake and extra rentals are listed separately so you can add them by choice.
Can you cater a corporate birthday or a kids' party?

Yes. We run corporate birthday package catering in Dubai as a clean office buffet or drop-off, and kids' bundles with familiar dishes, small portions and allergy-aware prep. Tell us the age and setting and we tailor the menu.
Do you offer halal and special-diet birthday menus?
Yes. Fully halal menus are standard, and vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free versions are built into the birthday package menu at no premium. Flag any allergies when you enquire.
How far ahead should I book?
A week is usually enough for a small gathering; book earlier for large parties and peak dates around holidays and long weekends. We'll confirm availability as soon as you send your date.
Is there an affordable birthday package option?

Yes. Affordable birthday package catering starts at the buffet and drop-off end from AED 700 per person, while luxury birthday package catering adds plated service, premium ingredients and live stations. Both start from the same honest per-head figure.
What can I get free on my birthday in the UAE?

Across the UAE, plenty of restaurants, cafés and loyalty apps will give you a free dessert, drink or main course on your birthday if you register your date in advance and bring ID. Catering works differently. With myCHEF the menu design, the written proposal and any revisions to it cost nothing, and vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-conscious versions of the birthday menu carry no premium — you pay for the food and the team, not for the planning around them.
Where can I celebrate a birthday in Dubai affordably?

Celebrating somewhere you are not paying for twice. A home, a villa garden or a rooftop you already have access to carries no venue hire and no minimum spend, so the budget goes on food and people rather than on a room; a restaurant or hotel birthday package usually folds a venue charge into the per-head price. After the venue, format is the lever. People searching for cheap birthday catering in Dubai are usually asking which format costs least, and the answer is drop-off or a buffet rather than plated service with dedicated staff.
How much does it cost to celebrate a birthday on the Burj Khalifa?

We don't publish other venues' rates, and the restaurants inside the Burj Khalifa set their own minimum spend per guest, which moves with the date, the sitting and the view — ask the venue directly before you plan a budget around it. What myCHEF can price is the catering itself: the same standard of cooking brought to a home, a rooftop or a yacht, where you pay for the meal and the people serving it rather than for the address.
For birthday package catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
